# =====================================================================
# Kehillah defines override -- registers the government type.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
#
# Creating a government type is not enough on its own. The engine
# preregisters twelve auto-generated modifier types per government
# (opinion, vassal_opinion, tributary_opinion, opinion_same_faith, and
# add/mult pairs for tax, levy, herd and prestige contribution), and it
# only does so for government types named in this define. A government
# missing from the list loads, but logs twelve
# government_type.cpp:160 errors of the form:
#
#   Could not find the preregistered modifier type
#   'kehillah_government_opinion' ... Are you sure the government type
#   'kehillah_government' is included in the define GOVERNMENT_TYPES?
#
# The error message names the fix directly. An earlier revision of
# docs/implementation/v1-kehillah-implementation.md dismissed these as
# unavoidable noise on the grounds that no such define existed. That
# conclusion was drawn from a stale CK3 install; the define is present
# in the live 1.19 build at common/defines/00_defines.txt.
#
# COMPATIBILITY COST
#
# GOVERNMENT_TYPES is a list, so redeclaring it REPLACES the vanilla
# list rather than appending to it. Every vanilla entry below is
# therefore copied verbatim from the live 00_defines.txt, in order,
# with kehillah_government appended last.
#
# Consequences, the same shape as the succession-law override:
#   - Conflicts with any other mod that adds a government type this way.
#   - MUST be re-diffed against vanilla on every patch that adds or
#     renames a government type, or those governments silently lose
#     their contribution modifiers.
# =====================================================================

NGovernment = {
	GOVERNMENT_TYPES = {
		"feudal_government"
		"republic_government"
		"theocracy_government"
		"clan_government"
		"tribal_government"
		"mercenary_government"
		"holy_order_government"
		"administrative_government"
		"landless_adventurer_government"
		"nomad_government"
		"herder_government"
		"celestial_government"
		"japan_administrative_government"
		"japan_feudal_government"
		"mandala_government"
		"wanua_government"
		"meritocratic_government"
		"steppe_admin_government"

		# --- added by the Jewish Communities mod ---
		"kehillah_government"
	}
}
